findings.title: Same concurrent-delete NPE remains in getSubGroupsStream overloads
findings.body: GroupAdapter.getSubGroupsCount was fixed to null-check modelSupplier.get() because the delegate returns null when the group was deleted concurrently. The three getSubGroupsStream overloads still do modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) with no null check. Under the same race the delegate returns null, modelSupplier.get() returns null, and dereferencing it throws NullPointerException, causing the same 500 failure this PR claims to fix. All paged/search subgroup lookups need the same null handling as getSubGroupsCount.

findings.title: Concurrency test asserts without joining reader thread
findings.body: The new test starts a raw Thread that loops groups() reads while the main thread deletes 100 groups, then sets deletedAll and immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty without keeping a Thread reference or joining. Exceptions that arrive after the assert are missed, the test can pass while the background request later fails, and the leaked thread keeps calling the admin client after the test/realm is torn down, causing flakes and cross-test noise. The test must join the reader with a timeout before asserting and stop hammering the server in a tight loop.
